title: Member Action Card: Acceptance of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)
content:
**Member action card — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**
**Acceptance of an offered agreement: `accept_payment_agreement_6d07adca`**

**The commitment.** Accepting the agreement is the member's own commitment, given within the tier's acceptance window of calendar days after the offer through one of the tier's acceptance methods, and the arranged amount the member commits to is recorded with the acceptance.

**When the arranged amount is fixed.** The arranged amount recorded on an acceptance is fixed only once every other agreement of the member whose missed installments have reached the default count shows defaulted status.

Read the other way: while any other agreement of the member has missed installments reaching its tier's default count and does not show defaulted status, the arranged amount to be recorded on this acceptance is not yet fixed.

**What the action records.** One call records the member's acceptance on their own service account: the agreement's status changes from offered to active, today's date becomes its accepted date, the way the member accepted is recorded as its acceptance method, and the amount the member commits to spread over the installments is recorded as the agreement's arranged amount. Afterwards the member sees the agreement as active with that arranged amount.

**Who runs it.** The acceptance is the member's own act. The representative unlocks the action with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the member — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format or values |
|---|---|---|
| `arrangement_id` | reference number of the offered payment arrangement, as returned by the arrangement lookup and read to the member by the representative | identifier, as shown |
| `service_account_id` | reference number of the electric service account the offered arrangement covers, as returned by the service account lookup and shown on the arrangement | identifier, as shown |
| `acceptance_method` | how the member gives the acceptance | exactly one of `recorded_phone_consent` (the member consents aloud on the recorded line during this call), `e_signature` (the member signs the agreement electronically through the link or app), `signed_paper` (the member signs and returns the printed agreement at an office) |
| `arranged_amount` | amount the member commits to spread over the installments | US dollars, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence of the form "Agreement ‹arrangement id› on service account ‹service account id› accepted on ‹YYYY-MM-DD› by ‹acceptance method›; arranged amount ‹amount› USD; status active." The date is today, the method is the one recorded and the amount carries 2 decimals. Receiving this sentence means the acceptance was recorded.

**Illustration (hypothetical):** a member signing at the district office passes `acceptance_method` = `signed_paper`; the return names that method and shows status active.
